_comment: The headline and the opening sentence, indexed by area then by tone.
Eight areas by five tones by five variants: 200 written pairs.
Tone is the aspect: charged = conjunction, open = sextile,
friction = square, easy = trine, pull = opposition.
Each entry is [headline, body]. The headline is the screenshot and should
be a short declarative with no hedging. The body is ONE sentence: the
reading is completed by a clause about which part of the chart was struck
(touches.json) and a clause about timing (motion.json), so three sentences
of writing arrive from three separate tables and the index multiplies.
Everything here is written to be true of the *aspect*, never of the
reader. The specificity comes from the measurement printed underneath.

charged: Today is about being seen accurately.
Something you have been doing quietly is about to be noticed, and it is better noticed as it is than dressed up first.
You are the subject today, not the author.
How you are read matters more than what you meant by it, which is uncomfortable and also useful.
Take the compliment properly.
Deflecting is a habit rather than modesty, and it teaches people to stop trying.
You are being quoted today.
What you say offhand travels further than the thing you prepared.
Stop auditioning.
The part is already yours and the performance is costing you the ease that got it.
open: The door is already open.
You do not have to build the case; the thing you would have argued for is available if you ask plainly.
Being visible costs less today.
What you would normally do quietly is worth doing where people can actually see it.
Ask before you over-prepare.
The permission you are assembling an argument for has probably already been given.
Go as you are today.
The version of you that has not been arranged is the one that works this morning.
Occupy the space you have already earned.
Nobody is going to hand it over more formally than this.
friction: Being right is not the same as being heard.
Something is pushing back on how you want to be seen, and arguing with it today costs more than it returns.
Do not defend it yet.
The urge to explain yourself will arrive well before the second half of the story does.
The room is not about you today.
Something else is competing for the same attention and it is not a slight.
You are not the problem, but you are in it.
Separating those two is most of today's work.
Let the misreading stand for a day.
Correcting it now makes it larger; by tomorrow it will have moved on without you.
easy: You can take up the whole room today.
Whatever you have been doing at half volume is worth doing at full volume.
Put your name on it.
The work you have been letting speak for itself will speak louder with your name attached.
Lead the thing you keep almost leading.
The hesitation is habit rather than judgement, and today the room will follow.
You are easy to be around today. Use it.
Ask for the thing while the room is on your side.
Say the thing you are known for saying.
It is not a cliche if it is true, and today somebody needs it.
pull: Two versions of you want different things.
One wants recognition and one wants to be left alone, and neither is wrong.
Your work and your name are pulling apart.
One is asking to be finished and the other to be shown, and today only fits one.
Being wanted and being known are different.
You are being offered plenty of the first; notice which one you actually came for.
You are being asked to be two people.
Pick the one you can sustain past Thursday.
Your reputation is ahead of you.
Either catch up to it or correct it, but do not keep living behind it.

charged: Ask for the number you think is too high.
It is roughly the right one, and this is a bad day for pre-emptive modesty.
The boring version is the correct one.
Something wants doing properly rather than quickly, and no shortcut here is worth the debt.
What you are worth is a fact today, not a feeling.
Look at the actual figures before you decide how to feel about them.
Do the thing you have been delegating to next week.
Next week has its own list and it has not been consulted.
Name the price out loud.
Whatever it is, saying it costs less than the ambiguity has been costing.
open: Structure is a kindness today.
Put the dull scaffolding under the thing you care about; it is the difference between it surviving the month and not.
Ask for the thing you have been earning.
It costs one conversation, and the answer is likelier to be yes than you are assuming.
Take the meeting slightly above your level.
The gap between rooms is always smaller than it looks from below.
The favour you need is one message away.
You have been solving alone something somebody would answer in a sentence.
Tidy the system, not the desk.
One process fixed today saves the same hour every week after it.
friction: The wall is real. Stop testing it.
Something is not going to move today however it is approached, and the effort is needed elsewhere.
Do less, properly.
Half the list done well will be worth more on Friday than all of it done at this speed.
Check the arithmetic before you agree to the date.
Optimism is doing the sums for you and it has never been good at them.
Working harder is the wrong lever today.
Something upstream is broken and effort is only making more of it.
Do not decide it while tired.
The judgement is off by exactly as much as the sleep is.
easy: Your effort converts today.
The work-to-result ratio is better than usual, so point it at the stuck thing rather than the easy one.
Finish the thing that is at eighty per cent.
Not a new one: the one that has sat nearly done for a month.
Discipline is cheap today. Bank some.
Start the habit small enough that tomorrow-you cannot find an argument against it.
Ship it before you improve it.
The improvement will be better informed once it is out of your hands.
Say yes to the boring opportunity.
It is the one that is still paying in a year.
pull: What you owe and what you want are not aligned.
Attend to the quieter one first, because it is the one that compounds.
The long thing and the urgent thing are not the same thing.
Only one of them will actually move today, and it is not the urgent one.
Money and meaning are asking for different hours.
You can serve both this week but not both this afternoon.
Ambition and rest are both correct today.
They are not compatible before six, so sequence them rather than blending them.
The job and the work are not the same thing.
One of them pays and one of them matters; today they want opposite hours.

charged: Someone needs your praise.
Skip the suggestions for improvement entirely and name what they are already doing right.
The message you send today gets read closely.
Every word is doing more work than usual, and that cuts in both directions.
Say the specific thing.
General encouragement bounces off; name the actual sentence, the actual hour of work.
Somebody is waiting for you to go first.
The silence is not agreement, it is politeness, and it will hold all week.
Put the difficult thing in one sentence.
If it takes a paragraph you have not decided what you think yet.
open: The conversation you have been avoiding goes fine.
It is shorter and far less dramatic than the version you have been rehearsing.
Ask the question you think is obvious.
Nobody else has asked it, and the answer changes what everyone does next.
Reach out to the one you keep meaning to.
Today it takes a message; in a month it takes an explanation.
Answer the message you have been leaving.
It is a two-line reply and it has been a three-week weight.
Say the good thing about someone to someone else.
It gets back, and it is worth more secondhand.
friction: Read it twice before you send it.
What you mean and what lands are further apart than usual, and softer wording is not the fix.
Half the argument is a definition.
Find the word you are each using differently before you defend anything.
Do not explain it a third time.
Repetition is not clarification; change the medium or leave it until tomorrow.
Assume they meant the kinder version.
They probably did, and if they did not, you have lost nothing.
Take the argument off the screen.
Whatever it is, text is the worst possible room for it.
easy: You can explain the difficult thing today.
The words are unusually available, so spend them on what you have been putting off.
Teach it to somebody.
Whatever you half-know finishes assembling itself the moment you have to say it aloud.
Introduce two people who should know each other.
It costs a minute, and today it actually lands.
Ask for the introduction.
Today it costs one line and it will not stay this cheap.
Have the long conversation.
The one that never fits; today it fits.
pull: Listening is the harder half.
The information you need is inside the part you would otherwise have talked over.
Two true things are being said at once.
You are trying to pick a winner; both of them holding is the actual answer.
The group and the person want different things from you.
Answer the person. The group will not notice either way.
You are talking to two audiences at once.
Write it for one of them and let the other overhear.
Being understood and being agreed with are different.
Today you can have the first. Take it and stop pushing for the second.

charged: Home is louder than usual today.
Something domestic is asking to be dealt with rather than tidied around.
Call the person you are from.
Not because it is owed, but because today it will be shorter and easier than you expect.
The house is telling you something.
Whatever you keep stepping over on the way past is the thing.
The thing in the hallway is not about the hallway.
Deal with the object and the feeling underneath it comes loose too.
Somebody at home needs to be asked twice.
The first answer was the polite one.
open: Twenty minutes on the room buys back the afternoon.
Sort the space before you try to do anything difficult inside it.
Say the softer thing at home first.
There is unusually little cost today to admitting how you actually feel.
Let someone in slightly early.
The version of this you would share in a month is the version to share now.
Make one room work properly.
Not the whole flat. One room, finished, changes the week.
Invite somebody in.
The house does not have to be ready; it has never been the point.
friction: Not everything at home wants fixing today.
Something small will feel much larger than it is, and recognising that is the whole task.
Do not renovate the feeling.
Making the room nicer will not answer the question you have been avoiding inside it.
The old argument is not today's argument.
You are answering something from years ago; notice that, then stop.
Do not reorganise your way out of it.
The tidying is real work and it is also the avoidance.
The family script is running.
You have heard yourself say this sentence before. Say a different one.
easy: Rest counts as productivity today.
The thing you would normally push through will go better if you stop first.
Cook for somebody.
It is the oldest and least complicated way to close a distance, and today it works.
Go where you are already comfortable.
The familiar room, the same walk, the person who needs no context from you.
Stay in tonight.
The invitation you would normally take is worth less than the evening you would spend.
Fix the small broken thing.
It has cost you a second of irritation daily for months. Today it takes ten minutes.
pull: Home and everything else are pulling opposite ways.
Choose one of them properly rather than doing both of them badly.
Where you are from and where you are going disagree.
They do not have to be reconciled today, only admitted to.
You cannot be the steady one everywhere.
Decide on purpose who gets your patience, rather than finding out by accident.
Roots and reach want different things today.
You can leave and still belong, but not without saying so.
Two houses want you in them.
The one you did not choose will understand better than you expect.

charged: Start it today or admit you won't.
The conditions are here and they are not here tomorrow in the same shape.
The idea is ready before you are.
Waiting for confidence is the same delay wearing a better coat.
Make the thing badly, on purpose.
A bad first version is information; a perfect plan is not.
The good idea arrived at a bad time.
Write it down properly now; it will not survive being remembered.
Show it to one person today.
Not the crowd. One person whose opinion you would actually change your mind for.
open: Play with it before you plan it.
The good version arrives through the hands rather than through the outline.
Say yes to the thing that scares you slightly.
Not the terrifying one: the one only just outside what you have already done.
Learn it sideways.
An hour on something adjacent will do more than another hour on the problem itself.
Reuse the thing you already made.
It is better than you remember and it is half of the next one.
Work somewhere else today.
The room has run out of ideas, not you.
friction: The blank page is not the enemy today.
The standard you are holding it to is; lower that and begin.
Do not add a new thing today.
The appetite is real and the capacity is not, so write it down for a fortnight from now.
Stop polishing.
It has been finished for a while and you are postponing finding out what people think.
It is not blocked, it is unfinished.
The part you are avoiding is small and dull, and it is the whole obstacle.
Comparing is not research.
An hour looking at other people's work today will cost you two of your own.
easy: It comes easily today. Do the hard part.
Spend the good conditions on the piece you have been going around.
Go one step past the plan.
The extra effort costs less today and compounds more than it will next week.
Make the generous version.
Whatever you make, cook, write or send will land better than it strictly deserves to.
Do the version you would do if nobody saw it.
That one is better, and today it also happens to be the one that lands.
Follow the tangent.
The detour is where the actual idea is, and today you have time for it.
pull: The idea and the deadline want different things.
One of them is negotiable and you already know which.
Finishing and starting are competing.
There is only enough for one of them today, so finish.
Play and duty are both legitimate.
Give each an hour and stop arguing with yourself about the split.
The thing you want to make and the thing you owe are different.
Give the owed one the morning and the wanted one the evening.
Craft and speed are both defensible.
Only one of them fits today; pick before you start, not halfway.

charged: What you want is obvious to everyone but you.
It is close enough to name today, and naming it costs less than the circling does.
Say the thing you like out loud.
Enthusiasm kept private stops being enthusiasm and quietly becomes a secret.
The other person is not a puzzle.
Ask them; it is faster than another week of interpretation.
Somebody is deciding about you today.
Give them the accurate version rather than the appealing one.
Say the unglamorous true thing.
It will land better than the good line, and it is the one they will remember.
open: Say yes to the small invitation.
The unremarkable one, not the exciting one: it is the one that goes somewhere.
Go first.
The gesture you have been waiting to receive is the one to make.
Ask how they actually are.
Not the greeting version; today the second question gets an honest answer.
Make the ordinary plan.
Tuesday, something small, nothing to live up to. That is where it actually happens.
Let them help.
Refusing is a habit and it reads as distance rather than as strength.
friction: Wanting it does not make it good.
Something attractive is available today and it is not free, so work out the price first.
The nice option is not the kind one.
Agreeing buys quiet and costs the week; say the awkward sentence while it is still small.
You are negotiating with someone who is not in the room.
Have the conversation with the actual person instead.
Do not test it.
Whatever answer you get from a test, you will not believe it.
The complaint underneath is not the complaint.
Ask what the actual one is before you defend against this one.
easy: Beauty is cheap today. Spend it.
Do the generous version of whatever you were going to do anyway.
The difficult conversation goes well today.
It will be shorter and warmer than the rehearsal led you to expect.
Be easy to love today.
It is not a performance; it is answering the message.
Say the thing you assume they know.
They do not, and hearing it is not the same as assuming it.
Do the small maintenance.
The message, the errand, the thing they mentioned once. Today it counts double.
pull: Comfort and desire are not the same thing.
One of them is asking you to stay and one is asking you to move.
Two people want different amounts of you.
Say the real number rather than quietly splitting the difference.
Independence and closeness are trading places.
You are allowed both, just not in the same hour.
You want to be chosen and you want to be free.
Both are allowed; only one of them can lead this week.
Somebody is closer than you are.
Either close the gap or say plainly that you are not going to.

charged: Say what you actually want.
The guessing has already cost more than the sentence will.
Something shared needs naming today.
Money, a bed, a debt: whichever it is, the vagueness is the problem rather than the thing.
Intensity is not the same as intimacy.
Notice which one is on offer before you agree to it.
The thing you have not said is the whole weather.
It is not going to come up naturally. It never was.
What you are owed and what you will ask for are different numbers.
Today, say the first one.
open: The honest version is available today.
Whatever you have been softening can be said plainly, and it will land.
Ask for the thing you assume is unreasonable.
It is considerably more reasonable than the assumption.
Let it be uncomplicated.
Not everything has to mean something in order to be worth doing.
Be direct rather than clever.
The clever version has been misread twice already.
Settle the money question while it is small.
It is a ten-minute conversation this week and an argument next month.
friction: The power question is the real question.
It is not about the thing the two of you are arguing about.
Do not settle this in the dark.
Whatever it is, it goes better in daylight and in words.
Withholding is a decision too.
Silence is not neutral today, and it is being read as an answer.
Do not trade honesty for peace.
The peace lasts until Thursday and the honesty was going to be needed anyway.
Jealousy is data, not instruction.
It is telling you what you want. It is not telling you what to do.
easy: Closeness is cheap today. Take it.
The wall you usually maintain costs more to hold up than to let down.
Sort the shared arithmetic.
Money, favours, whose turn: today it is a ten-minute conversation rather than a row.
Trust it slightly earlier than usual.
The evidence has been in for a while; you are waiting out of habit.
Say yes without the qualification.
The hedge you were about to add is protecting nothing.
Let somebody give you something.
Receiving badly is a habit, and today it would cost them more than it costs you.
pull: What is yours and what is ours are unclear.
Draw the line today rather than discovering where it was afterwards.
Depth and ease are pulling apart.
One of them is what you need and one is what you want.
You are keeping score and so are they.
Say the total out loud; it is smaller than it has been feeling.
Merging and staying yourself are both on the table.
You do not have to choose forever, only for tonight.
One of you is keeping the accounts.
Say so. Accounts kept privately always come out wrong.

charged: Something you believed is being tested.
It is not an attack; it is the first honest look you have had at it in years.
The far-off thing is closer than it looks.
Book it, apply for it, or admit out loud that you are not going to.
You know more than you are acting on.
The information has been in for a while and the delay is not analysis.
The question is bigger than today and today is where it landed.
Sit with it rather than solving it before lunch.
Something you were told is not yours.
You have been carrying somebody else's conclusion and calling it a principle.
open: There is more room than you are using.
You have been working inside limits nobody is enforcing, so test one today.
Say yes to the thing that widens you.
Not the terrifying one: the one that is only slightly further out than usual.
The generous read is the accurate one.
Where you could assume the worst of someone, the better assumption also happens to be true.
Read the thing you have been meaning to.
Today it will actually go in, which is not true every week.
Ask somebody older.
Not for permission. For the version of this they have already been through.
friction: More is not the answer today.
The instinct to widen, add, or say yes to everything is the thing that will cost you.
Certainty is not the same as being right.
The thing you are most sure of is the one worth re-examining first.
You are further from home than you meant to be.
Not geographically. Come back a little.
Do not argue about the big thing today.
Neither of you is going to move and both of you will remember it.
The doubt is doing its job.
It is not a failure of faith, it is the part where you check the load-bearing walls.
easy: Take the long view today. It is unusually clear.
The decision that has been confusing for a month resolves at a distance.
Learn something with no use.
It will turn out to have one, though not today and not obviously.
Go somewhere you have not been.
Even a different street; it does more than it has any right to.
Zoom out and the decision makes itself.
At a month's distance there is only one sensible answer and you can see it today.
Say what you actually believe.
Out loud, to somebody. It is different once it has left your head.
pull: Growth and stability are trading places.
You cannot have both of them moving at once, so decide which gets this week.
What you believe and what you do are apart today.
Close the gap in either direction, but do not pretend it is not there.
The private half and the public half disagree.
One of them is telling the truth, and it is usually the quiet one.
Faith and evidence are both asking for you today.
They are not enemies; they just want different hours.
What you say you value and what you spend on are apart.
Move one of them. Either is honest; the gap is not.
